entries.headline: Taiwan CDC adds publicly funded Novavax COVID-19 vaccine from October 19
entries.zh: 115年度公費流感及新冠疫苗接種踴躍 提醒符合資格民眾儘早接種 還可獲得健康幣 另10月19日起新增提供不同製程之Novavax公費新冠疫苗
entries.why: This is a public-programme (公費) change: Novavax (protein-based) joins the COVID-19 offer today, and the CDC says it plans additional flu and Novavax doses. Outlets frame it as an option for people avoiding mRNA vaccines and explain eligibility.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署10月19日起新增公費Novavax COVID-19疫苗
entries.why_zh: 此為公費計畫異動：蛋白質次單元疫苗Novavax今日起納入COVID-19疫苗接種選項，疾管署表示計劃增購流感及Novavax疫苗。媒體將其定位為不願接種mRNA疫苗者的選擇，並說明接種資格。

entries.headline: Flu vaccinations pass 3.24 million, COVID-19 passes 1.01 million; CDC projects next wave
entries.why: Public (公費) flu uptake is reported 9.5% above the same period last year, and the CDC has estimated the peak of the next wave. Both figures support the case that the programme is running ahead of last season.
entries.headline_zh: 流感疫苗接種逾324萬劑、COVID-19逾101萬劑；疾管署預估下一波疫情
entries.why_zh: 公費流感疫苗接種量據報較去年同期高9.5%，疾管署並已預估下一波疫情高峰。兩項數據皆支持本計畫進度領先上一季的說法。

entries.headline: CDC reportedly adds 500,000 flu doses as demand rises 15%
entries.why: One outlet reports an urgent 500,000-dose flu top-up, with Pingtung leading uptake. This fits the CDC's own plan for extra doses and points to tender and supply pressure in the public programme; the funding arena is not stated in the report.
entries.headline_zh: 據報疾管署因需求增加15%，追加50萬劑流感疫苗
entries.why_zh: 一家媒體報導緊急追加50萬劑流感疫苗，屏東接種率居首。此與疾管署自身增購計畫相符，顯示公費計畫面臨採購與供貨壓力；報導未說明經費屬性。

entries.headline: COVID-19 safety misinformation clusters on Threads; saline and stillbirth claims lead
entries.why: Posts claim the vaccines are saline, that stillbirths rose after pregnancy vaccination, and that vaccine DNA integrates into the genome. These are unverified social claims, not tied to a funding arena, and they are circulating just as a new brand enters the public programme.
entries.headline_zh: COVID-19疫苗安全性錯誤訊息集中於Threads；以食鹽水及死產說法為主
entries.why_zh: 貼文聲稱疫苗是食鹽水、孕期接種後死產增加，以及疫苗DNA會嵌入基因組。這些均為未經證實的社群說法，與公費或自費無關，且正值新品牌納入公費計畫之際流傳。

entries.headline: CDC assesses SV.2.4 COVID-19 variant; warns of election-season clustering
entries.why: The CDC is assessing the SV.2.4 variant reported in China, which was detected in Taiwan in August, and separately warns that election events raise clustering risk. Both items feed the urgency messaging behind the public (公費) programme.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署評估COVID-19變異株SV.2.4；警示選舉期間群聚風險
entries.why_zh: 疾管署正評估中國通報、8月已在台灣檢出的SV.2.4變異株，另警示選舉活動將提高群聚風險。兩者皆強化公費計畫的急迫性訊息。

entries.headline: Users discuss shot costs: clinic fees, willingness to pay, infant RSV antibody price
entries.why: Posts cover both arenas. On the public (公費) side, users report NT$150–200 registration fees for publicly funded flu shots. On the self-pay (自費) side, they ask what people would pay for a flu shot and cite NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV antibody.
entries.headline_zh: 網友討論接種費用：診所掛號費、付費意願、嬰兒RSV抗體價格
entries.why_zh: 貼文涵蓋公費與自費兩面向。公費方面，網友反映公費流感疫苗掛號費為NT$150–200；自費方面，網友詢問大家願意花多少錢打流感疫苗，並提及嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000。

watch.text: Outcome of the CDC's SV.2.4 risk assessment and its projected next-wave peak, both potential triggers for fresh urgency messaging.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署SV.2.4風險評估結果及下一波疫情高峰預估，兩者皆可能引發新一輪急迫性訊息。

qa.q: What exactly changed for COVID-19 vaccines today?
qa.a: From October 19, Taiwan CDC offers the protein-based Novavax COVID-19 vaccine within the public (公費) programme and plans additional doses. Media coverage centres on eligibility and on people who prefer to avoid mRNA vaccines. No items address self-pay availability.
qa.q_zh: 今天COVID-19疫苗究竟有何改變？
qa.a_zh: 自10月19日起，疾管署於公費計畫中提供蛋白質次單元Novavax COVID-19疫苗，並計劃增購。媒體報導聚焦接種資格及偏好避開mRNA疫苗的民眾。無任何報導提及自費供應情形。

qa.q: Is supply keeping up with demand in the public programme?
qa.a: Demand is running ahead of last year: 3.24 million flu vaccinations (+9.5% year on year) and 1.01 million COVID-19 vaccinations. The CDC says it plans additional flu and Novavax doses, and one outlet reports an urgent 500,000-dose flu top-up. No shortage reports appear in the last 72 hours.
qa.q_zh: 公費計畫的供貨是否跟得上需求？
qa.a_zh: 需求高於去年：流感疫苗接種324萬劑（年增9.5%）、COVID-19疫苗101萬劑。疾管署表示計劃增購流感及Novavax疫苗，另有媒體報導緊急追加50萬劑流感疫苗。過去72小時未見缺貨報導。

qa.q: Is there any new signal on enhanced (adjuvanted or high-dose) flu vaccines?
qa.a: Little. No recent item focuses on the enhanced vaccines offered in long-term care settings. Enhanced-flu mentions fell to 27 from 43 week on week, and high-dose mentions to 12 from 14, so the first-time enhanced procurement has slipped from the conversation for now.
qa.q_zh: 加強型（含佐劑或高劑量）流感疫苗有無新動態？
qa.a_zh: 很少。近期無報導聚焦長照機構提供的加強型疫苗。加強型流感提及量週減至27則（前週43則），高劑量提及量減至12則（前週14則），首次採購加強型疫苗的議題暫時淡出討論。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: The CDC's first uptake update of the season frames the 2026-27 public flu and COVID-19 campaign as ahead of last year and pushes high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署本季首次接種進度更新，將2026-27公費流感及COVID-19疫苗接種計畫定調為領先去年，並呼籲高風險族群於節假日出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: This notice formally adds Novavax to the public COVID-19 offer from October 19 and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, a direct tender and supply development.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告正式將Novavax自10月19日起納入公費COVID-19疫苗，並透露將增購流感及Novavax疫苗，屬直接的採購與供貨動態。

misinfo.claim: Stillbirths rose sharply after pregnant women were urged to get COVID-19 vaccines (attributed to a California nurse)
misinfo.note: Repeated across posts and attributed to a health professional, which makes it sensitive for pregnancy. Have maternal-safety evidence ready for health-authority, obstetric-society and HCP enquiries; avoid amplifying the post directly.
misinfo.claim_zh: 孕婦被呼籲接種COVID-19疫苗後死產大增（據稱出自一名加州護理師）
misinfo.note_zh: 此說法在多則貼文中重複出現，且歸於醫療人員，對孕婦議題較為敏感。應備妥孕產婦安全性證據，以回應衛生主管機關、婦產科醫學會及醫療人員詢問；避免直接擴散該貼文。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines are saline or fake
misinfo.note: Highest-engagement claim this week. Track whether it spreads into Taiwanese-language discussion of the new rollout; no direct response is needed yet.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗是食鹽水或假疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 本週互動量最高的說法。追蹤其是否擴散至台灣對新疫苗開打的討論；目前尚無須直接回應。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccine DNA integrates into human chromosomes and tumours
misinfo.note: Targets mRNA vaccines by name. Keep regulator-sourced references on hand in case media pick it up.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗DNA會嵌入人類染色體並引發腫瘤
misinfo.note_zh: 點名針對mRNA疫苗。備妥主管機關來源的參考資料，以防媒體報導。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines damage the spleen and immune system; detox products recommended instead
misinfo.note: Low reach but tied to selling alternative products. Note it for possible referral to platform or regulator if it grows.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗損害脾臟與免疫系統；改推薦排毒產品
misinfo.note_zh: 觸及率低，但與販售替代產品有關。予以記錄，若擴大可考慮通報平台或主管機關。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines killed 400 million people, contain parasites, or were rolled out without package inserts
misinfo.note: Fringe conspiracy content with minimal engagement; monitor only.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗害死4億人、含寄生蟲，或未附仿單即上市
misinfo.note_zh: 邊緣陰謀論內容，互動極少；僅需監測。

misinfo.claim: Hair loss caused by COVID-19 vaccination
misinfo.note: Single anecdotal post; log it alongside side-effect discussion trends.
misinfo.note_zh: 單一個案貼文；與副作用討論趨勢一併記錄。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Thin: one Threads post from a pregnant user recommends RSV monoclonal antibody for infants under one, cites NT$16,000 per dose and mentions a 32-36 week prenatal window; no brand is named and overall RSV volume eased (21 vs 27 items week on week).
products.implication: Cost is the visible friction in parent conversation, and the post blends infant antibody and prenatal timing, suggesting parents may not clearly distinguish the available routes of infant protection.
products.action: Prepare neutral, label-consistent reference material for clinicians on infant RSV protection options and keep monitoring parent forums for cost and timing questions; no outreach to the public.
products.signal_zh: 訊號薄弱：一名孕婦於Threads貼文推薦一歲以下嬰兒施打RSV單株抗體，提及每劑NT$16,000及孕期32-36週時程；未提及品牌，RSV整體討論量趨緩（週比21則對27則）。
products.implication_zh: 費用是家長討論中明顯的阻力，且該貼文混淆嬰兒抗體與孕期接種時機，顯示家長可能未清楚區分現有的嬰兒保護途徑。
products.action_zh: 為臨床醫師準備中立、符合仿單的嬰兒RSV保護選項參考資料，並持續監測家長論壇的費用與時機疑問；不對一般民眾進行宣導。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: Little product-specific signal this week (high-dose 12 vs 14 items; enhanced overall 27 vs 43). Context: Taiwan CDC reports strong uptake and plans additional flu doses, and media report an urgent 500,000-dose top-up, without stating vaccine type or brand.
products.implication: As elderly uptake is ranked by county and the second stage opens on November 2, questions may arise on whether enhanced doses are being extended beyond care facilities; the top-up reports do not say.
products.action: Prepare a factual brief on enhanced-dose allocation and supply status for policy contacts, and be ready to answer CDC or health bureau queries on supply timing before the second stage.
who: Taiwan CDC procurement and immunisation divisions
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，長照機構65歲以上公費計畫
products.signal_zh: 本週產品相關訊號少（高劑量12則對14則；加強型整體27則對43則）。背景：疾管署表示接種踴躍並計劃增購流感疫苗，媒體報導緊急追加50萬劑，但未說明疫苗類型或品牌。
products.implication_zh: 隨各縣市長者接種率排名公布、第二階段於11月2日開打，可能出現加強型疫苗是否擴及機構外對象的疑問；追加採購報導未說明。
products.action_zh: 為政策窗口準備加強型疫苗配送及供貨狀況的事實簡報，並準備於第二階段前回應疾管署或衛生局對供貨時程的詢問。
who_zh: 疾管署採購及預防接種單位
老年醫學科及家醫科醫師

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: No Tdap-specific items this week; volume dropped to 2 from 10, and the only recent mention was medical societies' earlier advice for chronic lung disease patients.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from the flu and COVID-19 dominated agenda, so there is no current issue to manage but also little visibility.
products.action: Keep monitoring; maintain evidence files on pertussis burden for adults and pregnant women ready for any society or CDC request.
products.signal_zh: 本週無Tdap相關報導；討論量由10則降至2則，近期唯一提及為醫學會先前對慢性肺病患者的建議。
products.implication_zh: Tdap在流感與COVID-19主導的議程中缺席，目前無須處理的議題，但能見度亦低。
products.action_zh: 持續監測；備妥成人及孕婦百日咳疾病負擔的證據資料，以因應醫學會或疾管署需求。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed by Sanofi; public from October 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added publicly funded Novavax from October 19 and plans additional Novavax doses; at least five outlets ran eligibility explainers ahead of launch, framing it as a different-process option.
products.implication: Launch week concentrates public and media attention on eligibility, clinic availability and early post-vaccination reports; the high-engagement COVID-19 safety posts this week do not name Novavax but could attach to a newly launched product.
products.action: Coordinate launch-week Q&A with Taiwan CDC and health bureaus on distribution and eligibility, confirm pharmacovigilance and media-response readiness, and track clinic-level availability reports.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質次單元疫苗，由Sanofi經銷；10月19日起公費接種
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起新增公費Novavax，並計劃增購；開打前至少五家媒體刊出接種資格說明，定位為不同製程的選擇。
products.implication_zh: 開打週民眾與媒體焦點集中於接種資格、診所供應及早期接種後回報；本週高互動的COVID-19安全性貼文雖未點名Novavax，但可能被連結至新上市產品。
products.action_zh: 開打週與疾管署及衛生局協調配送與資格相關Q&A，確認藥物安全監視及媒體回應準備就緒，並追蹤各診所供應情形回報。

issues.title: Novavax public launch week: availability and eligibility questions
issues.note: Media explainers already focus on who qualifies; expect queries on which clinics stock it and on the extra doses Taiwan CDC says it plans.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費開打週：供應與資格疑問
issues.note_zh: 媒體說明已聚焦接種資格；預期將出現哪些診所有貨，以及疾管署表示計劃增購劑量的詢問。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu eligibility opens amid strong demand
issues.note: With uptake above last year and top-up orders reported, supply adequacy and enhanced-vaccine allocation may be questioned when wider groups become eligible.
issues.title_zh: 需求強勁下，公費流感疫苗第二階段開放接種
issues.note_zh: 接種量高於去年且有追加採購報導，擴大接種對象時，供貨是否充足及加強型疫苗配置可能受到質疑。

issues.title: COVID-19 safety misinformation spilling into launch coverage
issues.note: Posts on stillbirths in pregnancy, saline and organ damage are circulating with high engagement in some cases; prepare factual, agency-led response routes rather than brand statements.
issues.title_zh: COVID-19安全性錯誤訊息擴散至開打報導
issues.note_zh: 孕期死產、食鹽水及器官損傷等貼文流傳，部分互動量高；應準備以主管機關為主導的事實回應管道，而非品牌聲明。

self_pay.title: Little direct self-pay stock or price data this week
self_pay.note: No items report clinic stock or prices for self-paid enhanced flu, Tdap or COVID-19 vaccines; one post simply asks how much people would pay for a flu shot.
self_pay.title_zh: 本週少有自費庫存或價格的直接資料
self_pay.note_zh: 無報導提及自費加強型流感、Tdap或COVID-19疫苗的診所庫存或價格；僅一則貼文詢問大家願意花多少錢打流感疫苗。

self_pay.title: Registration fees shape out-of-pocket cost even for public shots
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports clinic registration fees of NT$150-200 for publicly funded flu shots and asks which clinic is cheapest, showing price sensitivity at clinic level.
self_pay.title_zh: 即使是公費疫苗，掛號費仍影響自付費用
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友反映公費流感疫苗診所掛號費為NT$150-200，並詢問哪家診所最便宜，顯示診所層級的價格敏感度。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody price cited by parents
self_pay.note: A pregnant user's post cites NT$16,000 per dose for infant RSV monoclonal antibody, the only self-pay price signal for RSV this week.
self_pay.title_zh: 家長提及嬰兒RSV抗體價格
self_pay.note_zh: 一名孕婦貼文提及嬰兒RSV單株抗體每劑NT$16,000，為本週RSV唯一的自費價格訊號。
